name: Detailed Build Order Guide for House of Lancaster - Beastyqt
author: Tomioka2003

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ stay on @resource/sheep.png@, Start  @resource/rally.png@ rallying on gold @resource/resource_gold.png@ till 3
Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.png@
After 3 on Gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ start rallying @resource/rally.png@ on sheep @resource/sheep.png@ till @age/age_2.png@ Age-Up
Age up with Gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ villagers and build @abilities/repair.png@ @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.png@ Lancaster Castle
Shift @resource/sheep.webp@ villagers:  [ 3 on @resource/resource_food.png@ / 3 on @resource/resource_stone.png@ / 4 on @resource/resource_wood.png@ ]
Rally on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ till 8 vills @unit_worker/villager.png@ than on Gold @resource/resource_gold.png@

Build @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_lancaster/manor.png@  Manor under the influence of the @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.png@ Castle with your 2 Age-Up @age/age_2.png@ Villagers @unit_worker/villager.png@
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ on gold @resource/resource_gold.png@
Every time you gather 200 wood @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 100 stone @resource/resource_stone.png@
Build @abilities/repair.png@ another @building_lancaster/manor.png@ Manor with your gold @resource/resource_gold.png@ villagers.

After building 2 @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ Manors you DO NOT NEED villagers on your sheep @resource/sheep.png@ anymore as you are getting 70 food per minute from each @building_lancaster/manor.png@ Manor
Shift them to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@
Villager split after 5 minute: [ 8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ / 10 on @resource/resource_gold.png@ / 3 on @resource/resource_stone.png@ ]
Build 3rd @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ Manor and get the @technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.png@ Condensed Land Practices Tech from Manor which allows you to make +3 more Manors!
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ on stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ because we are getting  45 wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ per minute per Manor!
After @technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.webp@ has been researched make more @building_lancaster/manor.png@ Manors
Research @technology_lancaster/open_field_system.webp@ from Manor which allows you to make +3 more Manors [Total 9 Manors]
When you have 300 stone remaining in @resource/resource_stone.webp@ mine you stop gathering it.
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ on wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ till 12
Shift stone @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_stone.png@ --> @resource/sheep.png@ rally @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/sheep.png@
Make more Manors @building_lancaster/manor.webp@
try to make the last Manor with with 2-3 gold @resource/resource_gold.png@vills
Click @ability_lancaster/call_to_arms.webp@ from @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.png@ and get 11 @unit_lancaster/demilancer.png@
Make @building_military/barracks.webp@ / @building_military/archery-range.png@ / @building_military/stable.png@ from wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ @unit_worker/villager.png@
Age up @age/age_3.webp@ build @landmark_lancaster/kings_college.png@ Kings College
Make @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ research techs, get Economy Techs: @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@
Make @unit_lancaster/yeoman_age2.webp@ / @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@
At this point your Castle-Age @age/age_3.webp@ get more Economy Techs: @technology_economy/horticulture.png@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@

Get @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ Tech: @technology_military/bloomery.png@@technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@@technology_military/balanced-projectiles.png@@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@@technology_military/insulated-helm.png@@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@@technology_military/wedge-rivets.png@@technology_military/decarbonization.png@
Upgrade Units: @technology_lancaster/billmen.png@ / Veteran upgrades / @technology_lancaster/synchronized_shot.png@
Get @ability_lancaster/shire_levy_2.png@ from @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.png@ Castle when possible.

Make sure to get Tech from @landmark_lancaster/kings_college.png@: @technology_lancaster/hill_land_training.png@@technology_lancaster/burgundian_imports.png@@technology_lancaster/collar_of_esses.png@ and more
